govdocs-archive_org-nsia-HanrahanEdwarde:
A special grand jury returned an indictment in December 1970 over the Chicago Panther raid. The text preserved here charges a conspiracy to cover up the facts of the December 4, 1969 police raid. In that raid, two Black Panther leaders were slain in their apartment.

The raid had been defended as a shootout, and the cover-up charge attacked that official story at its root. A grand jury saying the facts were hidden moved the fight from newspapers into court. The indictment text lets readers see the exact charges the jury brought.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-JaganCheddPlots: Ponaie Hudkins wrote a letter on January 23, 1980 to a woman named Connie, whose surname is illegible. The file is kept under a heading about plots against Cheddi Jagan, the Guyanese political leader. The surviving record gives the writer, the date, and the partial addressee but no text, so the letter stands as dated correspondence filed with the Jagan material.
